answer_1.quote: ...We simulate the gradual evolution of true news into fake news using LLMs as agents within a social network... (Section 3)...
datasets: 120 true news pieces across five topics (politics, science, finance, terrorism, urban legends)
answer_1.outputs: Evolved news texts per agent over simulation days, showing progressive distortion from the original article

answer_2.quote: ...We employ GPT-4o-mini to automate FUSE-EVAL evaluation, scoring each dimension from 1 (minimal deviation) to 10 (significant deviation)...

answer_3.quote: ...We utilized GPT-4o-mini (and GPT-3.5-turbo) as evaluators, prompting them to assign scores for six deviation dimensions for each evolved news item...
methods: Prompt-based scoring of six FUSE-EVAL dimensions

answer_4.quote: ...Three annotators (Ph.D. students in Computer Science and Technology and journalism studies) were recruited to independently assess a representative sample of 50 news items using the same scoring guidelines...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored each of the six deviation dimensions (SS, NII, CS, STS, TS, PD) on a scale from 0 to 10 following predefined criteria.
